blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Pampanga Rep. Aurelio “Dong” Gonzales posted P90,000 bail in one of three of his graft cases before the Sandiganbayan Seventh Division over the weekend. The Seventh Division clerk of court told reporters that he posted the bail on Saturday. Sandiganbayan offices have a skeletal workforce every Saturday. The Office of the Ombudsman on Friday filed three counts of graft against former Gonzales Jr. over his alleged links to construction firms that secured public works contracts in flood control projects worth P611 million while he was in office.
